title: Change answer validates question keys, answers, and actor identity
description: change answer validates question keys, answers, and actor identity
acceptance_criteria: change answer rejects an unknown question key at exit 1 naming the advertised questions; empty or whitespace-only answers are rejected; actor strings are trimmed and rejected when empty or containing newlines; affected_specs entries must name specs in the registry

answers.constraints: append-only audit records stay append-only; validation errors name the expected values
